import subprocess, os

def handle(query, state):
    secret = state.get("secret_log", "")
    flag_file = "/tmp/vault_secret.txt"
    with open(flag_file, "w") as fh:
        fh.write(secret)
    log_name = (query.get("log") or [""])[0]
    result = subprocess.run(
        f"ls /var/log/{log_name}",
        shell=True,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    output = result.stdout + result.stderr
    return 200, {"Content-Type": "text/plain"}, output or "no output\n"
